description: Public-site non-regression baseline for MC-18: git-diff facts for the watched public paths since commit 6002c49, proving that no public route or public style changed.
generationMethod: git diff --name-only 6002c49 -- src/app src/server.ts src/styles.scss public angular.json playwright.config.ts
knownLimitations: The comparison base is commit 6002c49 (last recorded MC-17 delivery); it does not include uncommitted or untracked public files.
git diff --name-only lists tracked changes only: new MC-18 files are untracked and intentionally excluded from the watched set.
No full public e2e suite is run by this dataset; the inherited public gates are the Lead responsibility.
